subject.title: feat: add session stream mode command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a generic persisted `/stream` session command and `previewStreamingSessionOverride` capability contract for supported channels?
rationale: This is a new cross-channel, persisted product behavior and plugin-facing contract; source-level correctness cannot decide whether that permanent API and UX direction should exist.

options.title: Sponsor the shared contract
options.body: Accept the generic command and capability after current-head live proof demonstrates the supported channel behavior and reset path.

options.title: Keep the behavior channel-owned
options.body: Decline the shared capability and require any session streaming controls to be implemented and documented by individual channel plugins.

options.title: Park the feature request
options.body: Leave the feature request open without landing this product surface until a maintainer defines the desired session-control model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the shared contract
recommendation.body: Accept the generic command and capability after current-head live proof demonstrates the supported channel behavior and reset path.

likelyOwner.reason: No verified history-derived product owner could be established from the supplied read-only review context.
